age.evidence: Thirty-six male Wistar adult rats (270-300 g) were used in this study

sex.evidence: Thirty-six male Wistar adult rats (270-300 g) were used in this study

dosing.evidence: Rats were i.p. treated with ibogaine 20 mg/kg (I 20 ), 40 mg/kg (I 40 ) or vehicle... Dissolution of ibogaine-HCl to prepare the samples for i.p. injection was carried out using warm saline

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed four to five per cage

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12-h light/dark cycle (lights on at 07.00 h)... All experiments were done between 9 AM and 3 PM

assays.assay_description: 45 × 45 × 40 cm square arena with transparent plastic walls, indirectly illuminated (35 lux); 30 min recording of freely moving rats starting 3 h or 24 h after i.p. injection. Total distance traveled was tracked via Ethovision XT 12.0; serotonergic-syndrome behaviors (tremor, flat body posture, forepaw treading) were also scored manually every 5 min.

application_type.evidence: Rats were i.p. treated with ibogaine

setup_habituation.evidence: As rats were not habituated to the OF before drug or vehicle administration

setup_restrain.evidence: novelty-induced motor activity was automatically recorded by a camera

food_restriction.evidence: food and water freely available before and after i.p. injection of vehicle or ibogaine until behavioral testing

water_restriction.evidence: food and water freely available before and after i.p. injection of vehicle or ibogaine until behavioral testing

time_to_assay.evidence: starting 3 and 24 h after ibogaine or vehicle administration

sample_size.evidence: Vehicle group at 3 and 24 h (n = 6 per each group); Ibogaine 20- (I20) treated group at 3 and 24 h (n = 6 per each group) and Ibogaine 40- (I40) treated group at 3 and 24 h (n = 6 per each group)

outcomes.summary: Ibogaine 40 mg/kg did not affect novelty-induced locomotion 3 h after injection but significantly reduced total distance traveled 24 h post-injection. Ibogaine 20 mg/kg had no effect at either timepoint, and no abnormal serotonergic-syndrome behaviors were observed at the time points tested.
outcomes.statistics: two-way ANOVA treatment F(1,8)=11.14, P<0.01, η2=0.059; time F(5,40)=66.56, P<0.001, η2=0.75; treatment × time interaction F(5,40)=4.85, P<0.01, η2=0.055
outcomes.evidence: Whereas I40 was not effective to induce any behavioral alterations 3 h after i.p. administration, it elicited a significantly reduction of the animal locomotion 24 h after injection

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural assay (Open Field Test); consolidated as one assay.

B1: Scored 2 (4-6 measures). The paper explicitly measures total distance plus three specific scored behaviors (tremor, flat body posture, forepaw treading) = 4 measures. Followed gptoss reasoning over qwen's score of 0.
B4: Scored 1 (Yes) because tremor, flat body posture, and forepaw treading are species-typical behaviors from the natural repertoire being scored directly, even though they are drug-induced.

D1: Different cohorts were tested at 3h vs 24h (separate animals per timepoint per design), but the assay overall has multiple recording sessions at the assay level per rubric guidance on collapsing timepoints into one assay.
food_restriction/water_restriction: Set to 'during' because paper states food/water freely available in home cage but not in the OF apparatus; standard for short OF test.
Day/night cycle: scored 'no' (not flipped) because lights on at 07:00 with testing 9AM-3PM is standard light phase.
